Canadair Firefighting Debrief
Mission debrief

Canadair Firefighting

An agent has ten test drops to learn how a water load falls through today's air: drag, a wind that strengthens and turns with altitude, and the updraft above a wildfire. It then commits to one blind water drop on each of five hotspots. The mission score is the mean hit quality over the five hotspots, from 0 to 1.

Mission score by agent

Bars show the mean over all episodes. Each dot is one episode, so the spread across seeds and repeated runs is visible.

Table view

Where the points were lost

Missions cut short by a model provider's safety filter are left out here. For each episode two counterfactuals are replayed on the same world with the reference's own code: the reference fitting and aiming on the agent's test drops, then the reference aiming with the agent's final hypothesis. The differences split the gap to the reference into three decisions.
